Berlin Pride attack: One killed, 29 injured in suspected Islamist extremist incident

German authorities are investigating a van attack near Berlin's Pride festival that killed one person and injured 29 others. Investigators believe the incident was an act of Islamist extremist terror. The suspect, who allegedly drove a van into a crowd and then stabbed additional people with a machete, is currently being sought. The German interior minister stated that signs point to an Islamist attack.
